classification: Full-adoption scenario: gross value of time freed, not measured savings or net fiscal savings

assumptions.scope: Secondary teachers only; all modelled tasks adopted; primary/admin/local-authority/parent gains excluded

limitations: School counts are context, not the multiplier. The multiplier is secondary-teacher headcount.
No 43% reduction of annual working time is claimed.
Time saved has not been measured against human participants.
Rate of €40/h is an explicit analyst assumption, not an official salary or marginal cost.
Agent, infrastructure, deployment, support, maintenance costs excluded; no ROI or cash savings established.
Other actors are not added without a separate validated workload model.
Adoption and task fit must be validated; the nationally scaled scenario is not a forecast.
